source.title: Vitamin K2 mitigates cognitive, and motor impairments induced by multiple surgery with anesthesia and analgesia in neonatal stage.
source.authorString: Hou Y, Li S, Hou Q, Wang R, Xu X, Li Z, Ma L, Liu Q, Shen Y, Zheng H.

source_identity.authentication: Valid supplementary DOCX has exact article title and matching authors. Main native figure labels/models match the official abstract and authenticated supplement. Public assets served by Elsevier CDN under exact PII.
source_identity.asset_url_method: Standard public publisher asset paths were constructed for the verified PII; successful content identity inspected before scientific use.404 assets receive no source-reading credit.

conclusion.classification: Formulation-unresolved neuroprotective reserve with directly measured Bub1b RNA and BUB1B-associated tissue IF
conclusion.interpretation: This strengthens the prior hub-only description. Retain injury-prevention behavior and molecular recovery together, with unresolved dose/subtype/route and causal/specificity limits.

compound.vehicle: Corn oil, explicitly named as VK2 solvent in supplementary captions
compound.identity_limit: No MK-4/MK-7, medicine, retail supplement or other vitamin-family equivalence inferred.

model_timing.injury: Multiple surgery with fentanyl and sevoflurane (MSFS)
model_timing.route_limit: An injection drawing is not verification of exact route.
model_timing.timing_limit: Pretreatment/protection, not delayed treatment of an established impairment.

actual_functional_results.comparisons: MSFS+VK2 versus MSFS+corn oil; controls N-MSFS+corn oil and N-MSFS+VK2
actual_functional_results.untreated_null: Corresponding uninjured ±VK2 comparisons marked NS; no general baseline enhancement or equivalence established.
actual_functional_results.limits: Main captions, behavioral n, tests, protocol scoring and normalization remain unread. Native functional evidence is not a clinical ADHD diagnosis or a muscle-strength rescue.

BUB1B_evidence.RNAseq_context: Figure4 labels Bub1b down in MSFS+corn oil versus N-MSFS+corn oil and up in MSFS+VK2 versus MSFS+corn oil. Figure5C provides hub heatmap context; no raw DEG/adjusted-P replay.

mRNA.source: Figure5I labeled Bub1b, relative level of mRNA; abstract names RT-qPCR validation
mRNA.direction: injury-associated lower signal increased toward control after VK2 pretreatment
mRNA.nulls: N-MSFS ±VK2 NS; treated injured versus baseline comparison marked NS, not equivalence.

protein_associated_IF.source: Native Supplemental FigureS3A/E and authenticated complete caption
protein_associated_IF.assay_label: BUB1B immunofluorescence, relative normalized fluorescent intensity
protein_associated_IF.direction: MSFS+VK2 higher than MSFS+corn oil and toward control
protein_associated_IF.threshold_limit: Unusual notation preserved literally; not silently changed to P<0.0001.
protein_associated_IF.controls: N-MSFS+corn oil, N-MSFS+VK2, MSFS+corn oil, MSFS+VK2
protein_associated_IF.nulls: Uninjured ±VK2 NS; control versus treated injury NS is not an equivalence test.

BUB1B_evidence.interpretive_limit: Tissue RNA/normalized IF does not establish increased functional full-length BubR1 per cell, protein stability, kinetochore localization or checkpoint activity. Changes in proliferating/neural cell abundance or composition could contribute. No image-error allegation.

neural_marker_evidence.positive: VK2 increases injury-reduced Ki67/Sox2 andKi67/Pax6 double-positive fractions,GFAP-positive fraction andTuj1 normalized fluorescence.
neural_marker_evidence.unit_limit: S1 caption calls some measures numbers, native axes show percentages. Tuj1 is normalized fluorescence. Lineage tracing and cell-intrinsic differentiation are not independently established by these plots.
neural_marker_evidence.causal_limit: Marker/tissue recovery plus behavior is not proof that BUB1B caused neurogenesis or behavioral benefit.

genetic_and_drug_roles.fentanyl_and_sevoflurane: Components of combined injury paradigm, not restorative drug arms; their individual dose/contributions unresolved
genetic_and_drug_roles.hub_genes: Bioinformatic selection followed by molecular measurements, not genetic interventions established by inspected material
genetic_and_drug_roles.Ki67_Sox2_Pax6_GFAP_Tuj1_DAPI: Cell/proliferation/differentiation-associated markers or stain, not administered therapies

biological_units_and_statistics.IF_unit: mice per group according to S3 caption; no field count substituted for animal n
unknowns: multiple-testing and exact P definitions in main captions
biological_units_and_statistics.timepoint_limit: NAc sampling atP11 andbehavior atP30 do not establish individual-level paired mediation.

source_issues: SupplementS3 defines four stars asP<0.001; preserve as written, not a conventional threshold assumption.
S1 native percentage axes differ from caption number wording; describe measured fractions.
P30 native behavior timeline retained rather than inferring mature-adult or human clinical scope.
Supplement pathway table rounded zero P values are not treated as exact zero or new FDR results.

access_and_version_limits.partial_primary_access: Native Figures1–5 and complete supplement1.docx via public exact-PII publisher assets.

existing_ledger.recommended_change: Refine molecular evidence from hub-only to direct Bub1b mRNA and BUB1B IF, retaining family identity and all unresolved Methods limits.

followup_questions: Retrieve lawful main Methods/captions to resolve exact menaquinone, dose, route, antibody/primer specificity, assay normalization and biological allocation.
Separate per-cell BubR1 changes from tissue-composition shifts and test causal BUB1B dependence.
Determine whether benefit extends to delayed treatment or a BUB1B-deficient model without assuming it from injury prevention.

independent_review.scope: Bounded independent K2 native-figure/complete supplement/abstract review agrees with source qualification; full main/Methods remain unread. Root separately inspected the critical native panels and supporting captions.
